chain_words.nuance: to read quickly for the main points only
to look over a text in order to assess it
to examine the parts of something in detail
to examine something minutely, piece by piece
to examine a text very closely, looking for hidden flaws or meanings

explanation: These words all describe reading a text, from a quick skim to a minute and critical examination.

usage_notes.difference: 'Analyze' means examining the parts of a text to understand them; 'scrutinize' means examining closely and critically, often looking for flaws.
